title: Miniretain task spec v1
description: Single source of truth for the Go <-> Python boundary. Both sides load THIS file to validate and to fill defaults. Never hardcode a default in Go or Python separately.

job_id.description: Caller-visible job identifier, also the artifact directory name.

stage.description: Which Python worker stage to run.

workdir.description: Directory where spec.json / result.json / document.v1.json live.

source.description: Inline text to translate. A real build would pass a source_path here and the OCR adapter would read the PDF.

provider.description: OCR adapter name. Register real providers in python/ocr/adapter.py.
LLM client name. Register real clients in python/llm/scheduler.py.

batch_size.description: Items per LLM request. Missing key MUST use the same default on both sides.

model.description: Model identifier passed to the LLM client.
